title: Conditional κ = 0.000744118535019311: gen5 source retiming and target-prefix compression
body:
PR285's new gen5 circuit admits 880 source-frame retimings and 220 target-prefix groups discovered on its actual word. Their composition removes 1,109 local recursive calls and 440 scalar ADDs while preserving helper endpoints, rank mass and storage.

**Conditional κ = 744118535019311029483079 / 10^27 = 0.000744118535019311029483079**, **0.1794423% above freshly reproduced PR285**.

## Contribution

The new additive package is `research/gen5-retiming-targets/`. The source search derives its 880 legal frame changes from gen5's actual operand chronology. The target search examined 2,560 admissible prefix boundaries and found 220 four-target groups with exact dependencies. The latest admissible closes give no savings; earlier closes expose the useful relations. Neither selection reuses gen4 record indices.

| Quantity | PR285 baseline | Composition |
|---|---:|---:|
| Local recursive calls | 92,502 | 91,393 |
| Local scalar ADDs | 574,832 | 574,392 |
| Local rank mass | 411,356 | 411,356 |
| Normalized calls, 120 replicas | 11,438,160 | 11,305,080 |
| Literal stock, 120 replicas | 2,494,140 | 2,494,140 |

Source retiming removes 880 local children; targets remove another 229. The target transformation removes 1,760 prefix ADDs and inserts 1,320 setup/restoration ADDs. The two exact histogram deltas and all costs are derived from the final word.

The bank adapter uses exactly twice PR285's 60-replica layout, independently rebuilding all 411 endpoint charts and 9,531,600 assignments. Its gen5 price constant is derived from the actual initial rank sum, not copied from gen4. The complex supplier is unchanged.

## Reproduce and validation

With Python 3.11+, SymPy 1.14.0, GCC/C++17 and Boost headers, and PR285 checked out at `b40c1a3d8f40ee3764b9f13fe850f663f2d8c834`:

```sh
python -m pip install -r /path/to/pr285/research/five-stage-gen5-banks/requirements.txt
python -B research/gen5-retiming-targets/verify.py \
  --base /path/to/pr285/research/five-stage-gen5-banks \
  --output /tmp/gen5-retiming-targets --cxx g++
```

The full wrapper freshly runs all nine immutable PR285 stages, exports the actual word, rebuilds its native tools, and applies both selections. Exact signed source-span checks, 880 undersized-frame controls, target dependencies and omissions, rational Grams, chronological legality, bank assignments and 22,926 global formal columns pass. A separately authored Python checker verifies all 19,406 local columns forward and inverse, target omissions, unaffected events, bank-slot counts and the full primitive coefficient from literal costs. Ody's independent audit separately confirmed the composition and invoice.

The primitive coefficient is **180,164,370,784,684,201**. Signed row-L1 bounds are **46,393 / 2,303,032**; the payload bound is **95 bits**. The exact rational engines verify the fixed prime, eight ordinary levels and all 47 strict assembly inequalities, and reject the adjacent finite grid point.

Fresh complete local replay: **PASS**, 213.17 seconds, with the final package manifest `1671a02d8d254b69ae2cfba755cd11405420e9727aed34718aea88c4934e2c5a`. `make entrance-bank-verify`: **PASS**. [The full gen5 replay passed on Python 3.11 and 3.13](https://github.com/lydakis/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38035117964), and [the broader research suite passed all 52 jobs](https://github.com/lydakis/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38035117974). [Terminal elimination](https://github.com/lydakis/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38035117951) and [recycled registers](https://github.com/lydakis/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38035118034) also passed. All four workflows succeeded at signed commit `6b817d07454a458baa93a6185e885121cfb57b03`. These are verified runs on the author’s fork; upstream PR workflows still require maintainer approval.

The final word SHA-256 is `7afb22d4d11c0d558644ae18c9227180300fd242c819ae227e94e891decc5d60`. Sources, exact selections, scope and provenance are in `SOURCE.json`, `PROOF.md` and `MANIFEST.json`. Complete source membership and hashes are checked before and after execution; saved PASS receipts never replace fresh prerequisites.

## Scope and attribution

This remains a conditional finite construction. All inherited all-size compiler, weighted-chart, restored-row, routing, selector, prime-supply, precision/recovery, complex and analytic interfaces remain assumptions. Certificate success does not formally verify the full multiplication theorem. No practical speedup or linear-time result is claimed.

Prepared for George Lydakis with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including independent research and review by Ody. Our contribution is the gen5 selections and their exact composition, adapters, independent checks, source-pinned replay and CI. DreamingOfClouds' PR285 supplies gen5, with Anthropic Claude assistance. Dugongue's PR283 supplies the native audit/pricing machinery, with OpenAI Codex assistance. Rohan Arun's PR279/PR281 supply the retiming and target-group mechanisms and candidates; eumemic supplies target-prefix compression and the source527 lineage. Their full notices and inherited contributor chain are preserved. No exclusive priority or global-optimality claim is made.
